readout.H_NATIVE: Original full-vocabulary last-position native BF16 logits; logits_to_keep=1
readout.H_FP32: CUDA RTX5080 full F.linear, detached promoted same BF16 W and normalized h; no bias or post transformation
readout.precision_flags: Existing legacy allow_tf32=False API only; save/restore; autocast disabled; no newer setter mixing
readout.h_boundary: model.norm output at last prompt position, before lm_head
readout.tie_rule: Exact equality of finite stored values at maximum; earliest ABCD index; no epsilon
readout.native_replay: Require whole vocabulary bitwise equality, option equality, QKV equality and full validity; mismatch stops path
readout.fp64_scope: All 714 core cells, numpy float64 matvec; math.fsum product check on six fixed smoke cells

fp32_fp64_validation.reason: Conservative float32 reduction check for 1024 represented BF16 terms; not a tie tolerance; exact winners and gaps retained regardless

readout.native_h_roundtrip: Stored float64 vector must round-trip exactly through BF16

budget.retry: No retry of a failed cell; stop on any integrity mismatch

analysis.sampling: Within-task base-scenario clusters; identical indices across arms/readouts; tasks equal weight STANDARD; stress separate descriptive selected data
analysis.conditional_empty: null, undefined bootstrap draws counted, no epsilon
analysis.associations: Descriptive item-level Spearman only for finite nonconstant features; no p values; no classifier
analysis.head_units: dependent within scenario; not independent samples
